title: Could this attached image be improved in terms of the downscale algorithm?
author: OrbisMaximus
selftext:
I’m working on a Sega 32X crime sim called Project Babylon, and I’m specifically trying to improve the step from high-res art down to 320×200. I’m not asking about the art itself, only the algorithm / processing pipeline.



Right now I’m using mean-shift filtering, Sobel edge detection, edge-aware resizing, and light de-speckling. It’s better than a simple resize + sharpen, but I’m wondering if the current result still has too much noise or if the linework / face readability could be improved further just by changing the downscale method.
